Create a 4-column by 3-row sprite sheet, 2048x1536 landscape, TWELVE sequential frames of a slow controlled hand-over-hand DESCENT down a vertical steel cable. Each cell512x512, figure maximum180x290. Row-major order shows one COMPLETE smooth looping descent stroke: start left hand high holding weight, right hand just below; right hand gradually loosens/slides lower and regrips, knees flex gently and feet brace; transfer weight into lower right hand; left hand gradually loosens and slides down below right then regrips; transfer weight back, small settling motion returns to starting configuration. Subtle shoulder/hip/backpack/hair overlap. The body remains in place on sheet, game translates it downward. Do NOT draw walking, rappelling gear, ladders, ropes or cables. Maintain a believable firm hand anchoring her weight throughout. Draw small incremental motion, not wildly different poses.
